message: Logging must happen at the first layer (not re-logged downstream)

evaluator_config.message_template: Direct logging call '{module}.{method}()' — log at boundary layer only

rationale: Re-logging the same failure at multiple layers creates log noise, obscures the actual failure point, and wastes storage. The detection layer has the best context for a meaningful log entry.
remediation: Log at the first layer that detects the failure. Higher layers only re-log if adding materially new context.

guidance.explanation: The correct version logs only at the detection layer. The incorrect version re-logs the same failure at multiple layers, creating noise and obscuring the actual failure point.
